description: This file implements the MTA_Agent class, providing functions for managing MTA agent operations such as initialization, parameter management, health checks, session management, and cleanup. It includes external C functions for interacting with underlying system components and defines methods for registration, parameter retrieval and setting, and session control.

classes.name: MTA_Agent
classes.description: Class implementing the MTA agent functionalities including initialization, parameter management, session control, and cleanup.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Registers the MTA agent with the component registry.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Unregisters the MTA agent from the component registry.

methods.name: MTA_agent_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MTA agent session and registers it.

methods.name: MTA_agent_GetParameterValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from the system.

methods.name: MTA_agent_SetParameterValues
methods.description: Sets parameter values in the system and validates the change.

methods.name: MTA_agent_GetParameterNames
methods.description: Fetches parameter names and verifies against a list.

methods.name: MTA_agent_GetParameterAttr
methods.description: Retrieves parameter attributes such as access and notification settings.

methods.name: MTA_agent_SetParameterAttr
methods.description: Sets parameter attributes and validates the update.

methods.name: MTA_agent_Commit
methods.description: Commits parameter changes and verifies the commit.

methods.name: MTA_agent_AddTbl
methods.description: Adds a row to a parameter table.

methods.name: MTA_agent_DelTble
methods.description: Deletes a row from a parameter table.

methods.name: MTA_agent_GetHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the component.

methods.name: MTA_agent_SetSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID for the component.

methods.name: CreateObject
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MTA_Agent.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the agent.
